_comment: Cases shown as a single unnamed node on the map (no individuals listed). Each links to the colleges/orgs involved.

cases.label: Cornell 7
cases.description: Seven Cornell students accused in a civil lawsuit (filed Sept 16, 2026) of a sexual assault in October 2024 at the Chi Phi chapter house. No criminal charges have been filed; the Tompkins County District Attorney reopened the investigation in September 2026. Cornell expelled or suspended some students in 2024 and closed the chapter. Individuals are not named here.
